sara_support: FYI customer ACME-501 seeing a spike of tool/function-call schema errors after the model rollout at 14:02 UTC (we rolled r2.4). Error is consistently `tool_args_invalid: missing required field \"items\"` when invoking `order_lookup` tool. Happened during canary (~10% traffic).

sara_support: Repro curl (sanitized):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \n  -H \"Authorization: Bearer xxxxx\" \n  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \n  -d '{"model":"redwood-r2.4","input":"lookup order 123","tools":[{"name":"order_lookup","schema":{"type":"object","required":["order_id","items"]}}],"tool_call":{"name":"order_lookup","arguments":{"order_id":"123"}}}'
```

sara_support: Response from our platform (customer screenshot): `400 Bad Request - tool_args_invalid: missing required field \"items\"`

mike_infra: Can you paste the canary metrics? error % and exact traffic % to r2.4?

sara_support: Canary window 14:02-14:20 UTC. Routed 9.8% of traffic. Error rate for tool calls to order_lookup on r2.4 = 11.6% (baseline on r2.3 was 0.2%). Total API-level 4xx spike aligns with toolcall errors.

jia_ml: Sounds like function/tool-selection or arg serialization changed in r2.4. Did the model-side tool_call format change? Any changes to argument flattening or schema inference in the model patch notes?

sara_support: Patch notes mention tokenizer tweak and a small prompt template update for tool selection heuristics. No explicit tool_call schema changes listed. Customer says payloads that worked on r2.3 are now missing nested arrays (`items`).

mike_infra: Could be a regression in the model's serialization of complex args (lists/objects). Need full request/response logs from the inference runtime for one failed call. @deploy-bot can we pull the canary logs for r2.4 for trace id ACME-501-4f3a?

deploy-bot: logs pulled: https://internal-logs/redwood/canary/1972012240/ACME-501-4f3a (access limited) :robot_face:

sara_support: Copied relevant excerpt from runtime log: 
```
IN: tool_call -> {"name":"order_lookup","arguments":"{\"order_id\": \"123\"}"}
OUT: validator -> error: missing field 'items' in parsed args
raw_model_text: "call order_lookup with order_id=123 items=[]"
```

sara_support: Notice arguments are coming through as a string (JSON encoded) instead of an object; validator then treats items as missing. On r2.3 arguments were parsed as JSON object with items: [] included.

jia_ml: That matches a model-side change where serialization moved from structured tokens to a single JSON-escaped string in some generations. Probably the prompt template concatenation changed, or the model now adds quotes around the payload. We should check the postprocessing pipeline too (we do have a new joiner in r2.4).

mike_infra: Immediate mitigation options: 1) rollback r2.4 for this customer/route; 2) add a router fallback that does deserialization step (attempt JSON.parse when args is a string) in the runtime for canary cohort; 3) quick patch to the tool validator to accept stringified args and parse them. Pros/cons?

dylan_oncall: Given customer impact (~10% of their requests failing) and severity, I'm recommending rollback for the canary and pause rollout. I'll trigger rollback for the model variant on the affected route now.

dylan_oncall: Rolling back route redwood-r2.4 -> redwood-r2.3 for customer ACME-501 (canary cohort).

deploy-bot: rollback-started: route=acme-501/order-lookup, from=redwood-r2.4, to=redwood-r2.3, initiated_by=dylan_oncall, ts=1972012300

deploy-bot: rollback-complete: route=acme-501/order-lookup, status=success, ts=1972012345 :white_check_mark:

sara_support: Confirmed customer reports immediate drop in errors after rollback. Error rate back to 0.3% on r2.3. Customer very appreciative.

mike_infra: Next steps: (a) block r2.4 global rollout until we have root cause; (b) add a short-lived runtime compatibility layer to attempt JSON.parse when args is string to avoid future regressions while we fix model prompting; (c) add a breakpoint check in canary: if toolcall error rate > 1% relative to baseline, auto-pause rollout.

jia_ml: I'll reproduce locally with a minimal prompt to see when the model emits stringified args. Repro plan: run model r2.4 with same prompt template + temperature 0; compare generation tokens and run the postprocessing parse. I'll post findings in this thread.

sara_support: Ticket updated, customer looped in, and we offered a postmortem and ETA for fix. Marking as high priority. :pray:

mike_infra: Thanks everyone. Please add any additional logs or reproductions here.
